name: cosmic
label: Cosmic
css: .style-cosmic { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0f172a 0%, #1e293b 50%, #0f172a 100%); color: var(--text, #111827); font-family: 'Audiowide', sans-serif; position: relative; overflow: hidden; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; padding: 48px; min-height: 1080px; width: 1080px; box-sizing: border-box; } .style-cosmic::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; background: radial-gradient(circle at 20% 50%, rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.1) 0%, transparent 50%), radial-gradient(circle at 80% 80%, rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.1) 0%, transparent 50%); pointer-events: none; z-index: 0; } .style-cosmic > * { position: relative; z-index: 1; } .style-cosmic .hook { font-size: 80px; font-weight: 900; line-height: 1.1; letter-spacing: -2px; color: #ffffff; text-transform: uppercase; margin: 0; padding: 0; max-width: 90%; word-break: break-word; text-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.5); } .style-cosmic .text { font-size: 50px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.3; color: #e2e8f0; margin: 0; padding: 0; max-width: 85%; word-break: break-word; font-family: 'Audiowide', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.5px; } .style-cosmic .step { position: absolute; top: 32px; right: 48px; font-size: 160px; font-weight: 900; color: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.15); line-height: 1; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; text-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.2); } .style-cosmic .brand { position: absolute; bottom: 32px; left: 48px; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 400; color: #94a3b8; letter-spacing: 2px; text-transform: uppercase; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; } .slide-code.style-cosmic { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0a0e27 0%, #1a1f3a 50%, #0a0e27 100%); } .slide-code.style-cosmic::before { background: radial-gradient(circle at 20% 50%, rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.12) 0%, transparent 50%), radial-gradient(circle at 80% 80%, rgba(220, 38, 38, 0.08) 0%, transparent 50%); } .slide-code.style-cosmic .hook { color: #e0e7ff; text-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.6); } .slide-code.style-cosmic .text { color: #cbd5e1; } .slide-code.style-cosmic .step { color: rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.12); text-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.25); } .slide-insight.style-cosmic { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1e1b4b 0%, #312e81 50%, #1e1b4b 100%); } .slide-insight.style-cosmic::before { background: radial-gradient(circle at 20% 50%, rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.15) 0%, transparent 50%), radial-gradient(circle at 80% 80%, rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.1) 0%, transparent 50%); } .slide-insight.style-cosmic .hook { color: #f0f9ff; text-shadow: 0 0 25px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.7); } .slide-insight.style-cosmic .text { color: #dbeafe; } .slide-insight.style-cosmic .step { color: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.16); text-shadow: 0 0 35px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.3); } .slide-insight.style-cosmic .insight-text { font-size: 32px; font-weight: 500; color: #ffffff; line-height: 1.5; letter-spacing: 0.5px; padding: 24px; background: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.1); border-left: 4px solid var(--slide-primary, #3B82F6); border-radius: 4px; backdrop-filter: blur(10px); }
